avoid_supplements.name: NSAIDs (e.g., ibuprofen, naproxen)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: NSAIDs potentiate desmopressin's antidiuretic effect and increase risk of hyponatremia and water intoxication by inhibiting prostaglandin-mediated fluid excretion
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; use acetaminophen as alternative analgesic

avoid_supplements.name: Tricyclic antidepressants (amitriptyline, imipramine)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive antidiuretic effects increase hyponatremia risk through enhanced water reabsorption
avoid_supplements.action: Monitor serum sodium closely; consider alternative antidepressant class if concurrent use necessary

avoid_supplements.name: Selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (SSRIs)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: SSRIs increase ADH secretion and compound desmopressin's antidiuretic effect, elevating hyponatremia risk
avoid_supplements.action: Monitor sodium levels regularly; use lowest effective SSRI dose and consider alternative therapy

caution_supplements.name: Licorice (glycyrrhiza)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Licorice has mild mineralocorticoid activity and may potentiate fluid retention; additive effect with desmopressin's antidiuretic action
caution_supplements.action: Limit licorice consumption; monitor for edema and hyponatremia symptoms

avoid_foods.name: Excessive free water intake
avoid_foods.mechanism: Desmopressin increases aquaporin-2 water reabsorption; excessive water intake without corresponding sodium intake causes acute hyponatremia and water intoxication
avoid_foods.action: Restrict free water intake; advise patients on appropriate fluid management and sodium-containing food balance

avoid_foods.name: Licorice-containing foods/candies
avoid_foods.mechanism: High licorice consumption increases sodium retention and fluid reabsorption, compounding desmopressin's antidiuretic effects
avoid_foods.action: Limit licorice-containing products; encourage sodium-controlled diet

caution_foods.name: High-sodium foods
caution_foods.mechanism: Excessive sodium may worsen hypertension in susceptible patients; desmopressin causes fluid retention that can increase blood pressure
caution_foods.action: Monitor sodium intake and blood pressure; maintain moderate dietary sodium

monitoring_notes: Monitor serum sodium concentration regularly, especially in elderly patients, those with renal impairment, and concurrent use of medications affecting fluid balance. Educate patients on appropriate fluid intake, recognizing hyponatremia symptoms (headache, confusion, seizures), and the importance of medication compliance relative to fluid restriction.
